get.summary: Genre counts for a keyword track search

schema.description: SQL-style filter expression. Multiple conditions joined with ' AND '. Supported values: 'local_audio_url IS NULL' (missing audio), '(bpm IS NULL OR key IS NULL)' (missing metadata), 'apple_music_url IS NULL' (missing Apple Music), 'youtube_url IS NULL' (missing YouTube), 'soundcloud_url IS NULL' (missing SoundCloud), '(apple_music_url IS NULL AND youtube_url IS NULL AND soundcloud_url IS NULL)' (missing all streaming URLs).

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: 'lexical' is full-text + trigram. 'semantic' ranks by the natural-language 'context' embedding of q; 'hybrid' fuses both with reciprocal rank fusion, exact title/artist/album matches first. Semantic and hybrid return a single page (offset 0, limit at most 50), at most three tracks per release, and honour friend_id and filter. With an empty q every mode lists lexically.

parameters.name: bpm_min
parameters.description: Minimum BPM, inclusive. Applied in every mode.

parameters.name: bpm_max
parameters.description: Maximum BPM, inclusive. Must not be below bpm_min.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Exact musical key, case-insensitive (e.g. 'A minor'). Enharmonic spellings are not merged.

parameters.name: star_rating
parameters.description: Minimum star rating.

200.description: Per genre, the tracks adding that genre to the search would return: subgenres included, each track once, largest first. Takes /api/tracks/search's parameters; `genre`, `limit` and `offset` are ignored, so picking a genre leaves the others' counts in view. Genres with no tracks are omitted. Keyword search only: semantic or hybrid with words is a 400.

400.description: Invalid parameters, or a semantic/hybrid query

parameters.name: bpm_min

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Exact musical key, case-insensitive (e.g. 'A minor'). Enharmonic spellings are not merged.

parameters.name: star_rating
parameters.description: Minimum star rating.

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: Genre slug, id or name (a name resolves through aliases); repeat for several, which combine with OR. Each includes its subgenres, so 'latin' finds 'cumbia'. A track with genres of its own matches on those; one without falls back to its album's Discogs genres and styles. Applied in every mode. An unknown genre is a 400.

parameters.name: include_similar
parameters.description: Widen genre to each seed genre's top related genres from genre_similarity (#485), each expanded to its own subgenres too. The genres this added are named in the response's added_genres. Off by default: results are unchanged unless set.

parameters.name: similar_limit
parameters.description: Per-seed cap on related genres pulled in when include_similar is set. Defaults to 5.

parameters.name: similar_exclude
parameters.description: Related-genre ids to leave out of the widening even though include_similar is set — how the UI drops one of the added_genres chips.

mode.description: The mode that ranked hits; omitted for a plain lexical request.

degraded.description: Hybrid fell back to lexical results because the semantic leg failed.

added_genres.description: Genres include_similar added beyond the plain genre filter (#485); omitted when it added nothing.

429.description: Too many semantic searches from this caller; see Retry-After
